gpt.text:
You can proceed exactly with those three commands in order. I can’t execute them from here, but I can tell you what each one will do, what to watch for, and what to paste back if you want me to help interpret results.

## 1) Run AUB module autopilot + select best
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
```
**Purpose:** explores module-level candidates defined in `module_registry.yaml`, runs evaluations, and (with `--select-best`) updates whatever “current/best” pointer your framework uses when it finds an improvement.

**Watch for:**
- Any “improved champion” / “promoted” messages
- Failures due to missing deps, timeouts, or malformed candidate specs
- Whether results show movement on both:
  - `tuning_mean/min`
  - `lockbox_mean/min` (often the gatekeeper for regressions)

**If it fails:** paste the last ~100 lines of stderr/stdout and the name of the candidate it was on.

## 2) Run system-level autopilot on system candidates
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
```
**Purpose:** evaluates end-to-end/system candidates (often combinations or higher-level configurations) defined in `system_candidates.yaml`.

**Watch for:**
- Any regressions on lockbox metrics (especially `lockbox_min`)
- Whether it produces a new PASS candidate or stays inconclusive

## 3) Generate next-fix report
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
**Purpose:** writes a prioritized “what to try next” / “why things are failing” report into:
`baseline/reports/next_fix.md`

**What to do with it:** paste the contents (or key sections: top recommendations + any “blocking issues”) and I’ll help translate it into the next concrete candidate(s) to implement.

---

## What I need from you after running
Paste back:

1) The final summary lines from command (1) including any “selected best” / updated champion reference  
2) The final summary lines from command (2) including best system candidate metrics  
3) The `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` contents (or at least its top section)

If you want, also paste the path(s) to any generated run artifacts/log directories so we can drill into a specific failure.
